name: remote-review-channel-authority
title: Reconcile the two contracts that both claim remote-review authority
description: The user-global push hook in ~/.claude/settings.json instructs a direct Copilot request after every push; sd-review's SKILL.md forbids exactly that as a router fallback. Both fired on PR #81. The router reports absent because config/routed-review-setup-v1.json -- review.py:31 DEFAULT_DESCRIPTOR_PATH -- does not exist in this repository, so the forbidden channel is currently the only remote review that runs. Decide which contract owns remote review here and make them agree.
creator: sdelmas
